# Strip-log gallery

This catalogue renders the production JavaScript wrappers against the same
TRK-241 GSWA examples used by the visual-regression suite. Standard
`TracePlot` coverage includes numeric, categorical, comment, and structural
tracks. `BaselodeStripLogToolUI` coverage includes the numeric and categorical
families it currently supports. Each image is a committed baseline, so changes
to wrapper controls, geometry, colour, labels, spacing, or rendering are visible
during review.

## Regenerating the gallery

From `demo-viewer-react/app`:

```bash
npm run capture:striplogs
```

The command deliberately updates the desktop and mobile baselines, then rebuilds
this page from `visual-baselines/strip-log-manifest.json`. Use
`npm run test:visual` to compare the current render without changing any images.
